answer: The nectar schedule is applied in plume and willow reveals each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split thus 52% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1500 identities would post 2410 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
